subject: gk
question:
Consider the following statements with respect to the purpose of privatisation:

(i) It improves financial discipline.

(ii) It facilitates modernization.

(iii) It helps in improving performance of the PSUs.

Choose the correct answer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**All (i), (ii) and (iii) are true **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It improves financial discipline:
 
• Privatization often introduces greater financial accountability and efficiency because private companies are driven by profit
